top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Fence Gates Around Swimming Pool - Self-closing/ Self-latching/Locked (26 TAC §747.4807(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The pool does not have self-closing or self-latching hardware. A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.1207(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Pre-Employment affidavit was not made available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit (26 TAC §747.1207(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers do not have to review  a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form.
